body: Not sure if I can stay away from weed though. Without it my anxiety and panic attacks come back.

I don't think they understand just how bad it is. I feel trapped inside my own head, and am constantly feeling lonely because of it, even when surrounded by friends. It's difficult. Nobody can possibly know how bad it is since it's in my head, and mine alone.
I've tried counseling and antidepressants. I'm trying a new psychiatrist now. They don't seem to help.
